contract.representation: same normalized 512-channel pre-head feature; no alternative layer, projection, PCA, head blending or fitted transform
contract.population: same seven annotation-exposure-v1 pairs; both 200-frame windows and all four phases; all forty calibration identities accounted; RUBATO remains expressive/untyped
contract.clock: reuse oracle_period_paired_audit phase-continuous clocks and geometry guard, nominal pre/post periods and transferred boundary; not an automatic locator
contract.comparison: mean over common target frames of cosine(h(t), h(previous full candidate cycle)) minus cosine(h(t), h(previous half candidate cycle)); float64 interpolation then unit normalization
contract.support: intersection for all eight clocks inside the same half-open 200-frame window; integer target frames 0..199; both interpolation endpoints must be owned; no wrap, padding, extrapolation, or neighboring-window features
contract.boundary: report pre/post target counts and owner-crossing target counts per clock; zero norm at any required sample invalidates the whole window; any rejected member rejects the pair, without replacement
contract.phase: lag differences analytically cancel absolute phase and half-phase offsets; retain all four conditions and both half phases but do not count them as independent evidence
contract.decision: correct native constant/step must beat the other native shape in both windows at all four phases; density resolution additionally requires beating all seven rivals; any eligible failure forbids promotion of this fixed rule
contract.authored: 25-frame pre-period; post-periods 12.5 and 40; boundary 100; clean, alternating pulse omissions and 1/8 weak pulses with a persistent phase cue; flat/zero, half/double identical-observation ambiguity, edge support and owner seams
contract.interpretation: authored hidden trajectories are algebra controls, not model outputs or synthesized music; no information-free observation can certify a latent clock; no training necessity claim from a failed metric

observation_provenance: exact known filename/null to manifest-id/hash spelling; every other field exact
